details: dir             Published site directory; default: public
--headed        Show the browser window
--trace         Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>     Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>  Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--page <path>   Published appearance settings page; default: /appearance/
--from <path>   Page whose settings link and history return are checked; default: /about/
swban check/browser/appearance.webkit ./preview
swban check/browser/appearance.webkit ./preview --headed
swban check/browser/appearance.webkit ./preview --trace --out ./browser-report
